sentences.text: Lahore -LRB- -LSB- lə ` hɔər -RSB- -RRB- -LRB- -LSB- , -LSB- -RRB- is the capital city of the Pakistani province of Punjab .	Punjab	Punjab, Pakistan	capital city	capital city	city	city
It is the second most populous city in Pakistan and the 32nd most populous city in the world .	Pakistan	Pakistan	city	city	32nd most populous	List of cities proper by population
The city is located in the north-eastern end of Pakistan 's Punjab province , near the border with the Indian state of Punjab .	Punjab	Punjab, Pakistan	Pakistan	Pakistan	city	city

Lahore is ranked as a beta - world city , and is one of Pakistan 's wealthiest cities with an estimated GDP of $ 58.14 billion -LRB- PPP -RRB- as of 2014 .	Pakistan	Pakistan	city	city	PPP	Purchasing power parity
Lahore is the historic cultural centre of the Punjab region , and is the largest Punjabi city in the world .	Punjab	Punjab, Pakistan	city	city	Punjab region	Punjab region	Punjabi	Punjabis

The city has a long history , and was once under the rule of the Hindu Shahis , Ghaznavids , Ghurids , and the Delhi Sultanate .	city	city	Ghaznavids	Ghaznavids	Ghurids	Ghurid dynasty	Delhi Sultanate	Delhi Sultanate
Lahore reached the height of its splendour under the Mughal Empire , serving as its capital city for a number of years .	capital city	capital city	city	city	Mughal Empire	Mughal Empire

The city was captured by the forces of Persian Safavid Emperor Nader Shah during his invasion of the Mughal Empire .	city	city	Mughal Empire	Mughal Empire	Persian Safavid	Safavid Empire	Nader Shah	Nader Shah	invasion of the Mughal Empire	Nader Shah's invasion of the Mughal Empire

The city was then contested between different powers before it became capital of the Sikh Empire , and then the capital of the Punjab under British rule .	Punjab	Punjab, Pakistan	city	city	Sikh Empire	Sikh Empire	British rule	British Raj

Lahore was central to the independence movements of both India and Pakistan , with the city being the site of both the declaration of Indian Independence , and the resolution calling for the establishment of Pakistan . Lahore is one of Pakistan 's most liberal and cosmopolitan cities .	Pakistan	Pakistan	liberal	liberalism

Lahore is a major centre for Pakistan 's publishing industry , and remains the foremost centre of Pakistan 's literary scene .	Pakistan	Pakistan
The city is also a major centre of education in Pakistan , with some of Pakistan 's leading universities based in the city .	Pakistan	Pakistan	city	city
